info.title: Provider Restricted Apprenticeships API
info.description: API for managing restricted apprenticeship courses for providers.

get.summary: Get the restricted apprenticeship courses for a provider.

parameters.name: SearchTerm
parameters.description: The search term to filter restricted courses.

parameters.name: DeliveryStatus
parameters.description: The delivery status to filter restricted courses. Multiple values can be provided.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number for pagination.

404.description: Provider not found or no restricted apprenticeship courses available.

ProviderName.description: The legal name of the provider.

BackLinkUrl.description: URL for the backlink to the provider summary.

RestrictACourseUrl.description: URL for the restrict a course functionality.

SuccessBannerMessage.description: Message displayed in the success banner.

HasActiveFilters.description: Indicates if active filters are applied.

TotalCount.description: Total count of restricted apprenticeship courses.

Courses.description: Paged list of restricted apprenticeship courses.

Pagination.description: Pagination details for restricted apprenticeship courses.

Title.description: The title of the apprenticeship course.

Level.description: The level of the apprenticeship course.

ChangeUrl.description: URL for changing the restriction of the apprenticeship course.

LarsCode.description: The LARS code of the apprenticeship course.

DeliveryStatus.description: The delivery status of an apprenticeship course.

Authorization.description: Bearer token for accessing the API.
